scope: Host music file-allocation audit; hardware memory report pending

validation.independent_allocation_ledger: Linker wraps real malloc/free; tracks live pointer sizes independently of player status
validation.fake_console_path: KUI_ON_CONSOLE mutex/thread stubs validate lock contracts; not actual hardware scheduling

interpretation: The five retained bundled WAVs occupy about 4.46 MiB; temporary and custom files are accounted separately.
Manual selection of a bundled path formerly duplicated its bytes in a custom slot. It now shares the corresponding bundled cache.
No retained file-allocation leak was reproduced by these host cases. This does not establish the absence of a console audio-stack leak.
No Omikron hardware log accompanied this report. The owner's approximate 9 MiB observation is not a measured hardware result in this record.
Existing main-RAM accounting treats allocator free space as available; a peak or arena size must not be mistaken for current live memory.
A separate replacement/Resume use-after-free race was reproduced and fixed. It is not evidence that the reported 9 MiB was a leak.

replacement_resume_regression.test: Fake-console mutex unlock hook calls public Resume at every release boundary during selected custom replacements
replacement_resume_regression.fix: Cache publication and custom PCM selection occur under the same audio lock; no freed prior loop is exposed to Resume
replacement_resume_regression.after_fix_result: Both music test targets pass; sixteen selected custom replacements with more than sixteen Resume interleavings
